facts.fact: The High Commission for Digitalisation presented an SDK for secure biometric documents (passport, national ID card, driving licence) to the Ministry of Knowledge Economy, Startups and Micro-enterprises, as components for digital solutions that require identity verification.

systems.system: National digital identity (enrolment via dzds.dz, biometric match)
systems.owner: High Commission for Digitalisation with the Interior Ministry

systems.system: National interoperability system / secure digital link network
